Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy
public final class ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy extends Object
Evaluates one installed-capacity alternative against a common deterministic production-search policy.

The study resolves one direct CapacityConstraint by its stable area::equipment/constraint address, freezes its complete observable state, evaluates the baseline, applies and verifies the proposed applicable limit, evaluates the alternative, and finally restores both the installed constraint and the pre-study process operating point. Every result is immutable and serializable; no live model, equipment, constraint, search callback, or metric callback is retained.

A result is paired simulator evidence for the declared candidate set. It is not proof of causal production loss, global optimality, a KKT multiplier, design adequacy, certified emissions, or investment approval. Physical, energy, emission, and economic metrics remain separate and are compared only through identical metric definitions and units.

    • ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy

      public ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy(String id, String name, String provenance, ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator evaluator, ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.CapacityAlternative alternative, ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.ScenarioSearch search, int objectiveIndex)
      Creates a paired debottleneck study.
      Parameters:
      id - stable study identifier
      name - human-readable study name
      provenance - engineering provenance for the study configuration
      evaluator - configured process-model evaluator
      alternative - installed-capacity alternative
      search - common search policy used for baseline and alternative
      objectiveIndex - objective used for the paired delta
